issues: TypeScript compilation errors: `expo-app/src/screens/SignInScreen.tsx` uses `accessibilityRole="main"` on a View (around line 52) which is not a valid React Native role; change to a valid role (e.g., remove the prop or use "none"). Also the style definitions for `title`, `linkText` (lines ~102‑106) spread `theme.typography.*` which gives `fontWeight` a generic `string` type, causing TS2769 errors. Fix by typing the theme object with `as const` or casting the styles, or replace the spread with explicit literal values that match the `TextStyle` union.

TS2769 error in `expo-app/src/screens/ReceiptCaptureScreen.tsx` at line 130 where a `<Text>` receives `style={styles.message}`; the `styles.message` spreads `theme.typography.body` and results in `fontWeight` being typed as `string`. Adjust the theme typings (e.g., add `as const`), or explicitly type the style as `TextStyle` so the fontWeight literal is accepted.

UI primary flow failure: clicking the "Don’t have an account? Sign up" link on the Sign‑In screen times out. The link is a `<Pressable>` with `accessibilityRole="link"` but the automation cannot locate it. Change the implementation to a more robust clickable component (e.g., `<TouchableOpacity>` or `<Pressable accessible={true}>`) and ensure the `accessibilityLabel` exactly matches the visible text, or add a `testID` that the flow can target. This will allow the test to navigate to the Sign‑Up screen.

Accessibility color‑contrast violations: some UI elements (e.g., link text using `theme.colors.primary` #0066FF on the light background `theme.colors.background` #F5F6FA) do not meet WCAG AA contrast ratios. Adjust the color palette – for example use a darker shade for primary text on light backgrounds or change link color to `theme.colors.onSurface` – so that all text meets a minimum contrast of 4.5:1.

Insecure token storage: `expo-app/src/auth.ts` stores the JWT in `AsyncStorage`. The specification requires using `expo-secure-store` for secure device storage. Replace the AsyncStorage calls with `SecureStore.setItemAsync`, `SecureStore.getItemAsync`, and `SecureStore.deleteItemAsync` from `expo-secure-store`.
feedback: The app passes functional tests but fails static validation due to TypeScript type errors, accessibility contrast issues, a broken navigation link, and does not meet the security requirement for token storage. Fix the TypeScript errors, improve color contrast, ensure the sign‑up link is clickable in the UI flow, and store JWTs securely with expo‑secure‑store. After these changes the static checks should pass and the solution will meet the task specifications.
